passages.text: Users can sign in with email and password. Account owners can invite team members.
Paid subscriptions are billed monthly in USD. Account owners can download billing invoices.
CSV exports are available on every plan.
CSV exports are available on paid plans only. Free-plan users cannot export CSV.
Email support is available Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 17:00 UTC. Live chat is not offered.
